main_text.p: dunt[?] putridi illi halitus ex lacubus, spelúncis[?], brutorum cadaueribus putrefactis exhalantes corporaq; noftra inficientes. Qui verò ex hu-manis corporibus, diæteq; culpa, vt ptauis ali-mentis humoribusq; putridis, communes mor-bos oriti poffe inficiantur, contendentes mor-bum communem effe, cuius femper commu-nis fit caufa, videlicet aer venenatus, conta-giofus, nonconfiderant poffe in nobis ge-nerari fubftantiam quandam eiufdem cum ve-neno ideæ[?] & characterifmi, æquè pernitiofam contagiofamq; vt ipfa peftilens eft. In annonæ æftuantis caritate quot funt qui alimentis prauis, vt bulbis, brafficis, raphanis, cæpis, oleribus agreftibus, radicib?, arborumq; foliis & germinib?, vefcétes grauiffimis poftea mor-bis correpti funt? eiufmodi cibis magnos fæpè exercitus deletos effe conftat. Validos exerci-tus fœdarum aquarū potū concidiffe, quin etiā frugū viciatarū vfu, hiftorie tradunt. Fit namq; interdū vt diutiffimè feruata frumenta ac cere-alia femina putrefcant, & malè condita repofi-taq; humoré contrahant atq; fitū. Hipp. refert; eos qui leguminib? in Ænofame prémente in cibatu vfi fuiffent, crurib. debilitatos, genuúq; dolore tentatos: quafdam n.tetras iniqui fucci legumina oleraq; producere in cófeffo eft. Sed quid multis? Ex variis cibis diuerfarū qualitatū, viriūq; contrariarū difficiles & contumaces ægritudines generari nemo inficiabit, qui alios

page.notes: Several words are doubtful: "dunt" (line 1), "spelúncis" (the printed form looks like "fpelúnéis"), "ideæ" and "radicib?" and "germinib?" as printed; "prémente" in the Greek-name line. Abbreviations and spellings are kept as printed. The catchword "acres;" is at the foot right and is not repeated in the text.
